The Appalachian's are a mountain range in the US spanning from Maine to Georgia where many Scot, Irish, German and other northern European peoples settled. The mountains have few long ridges and many "hollers" and small creeks isolating people who, as the crow flies, don't live far from each other. It has always been a relatively impoverished area, it's main resource being coal and timber. The people in these regions were known as being a very hearty, self sufficiant types who had many good lessons on how to live such lifes.
